Catalogs Used in TROVE

Catalogs Used in TROVE#

The table below lists all of the tables we use in TROVE for associating targets with galaxies, (variable) stars (i.e., point sources), and/or AGN. This table will be more up to date than that presented in Franz et al., in prep as our catalogs in use evolve with time.
